refinement.intent: faithful cleanup and culturally neutral fictional paint without redesign
refinement.prompt_summary: Preserve the exact living full-body warrior identity, anatomy, proportions, face, expression, horned skull headdress, bone-and-leather armor, clothing, footwear, plates, spikes, massive two-handed spiked mace, both hands, and overhead pose. Remove only scene, base, text, flecks, and compression artifacts; isolate on genuine transparent alpha; clean and upscale. Add conspicuous irregular culturally neutral charcoal-black and muted iron-red siege stripes plus restrained dried blood, dust, and grime on exposed skin. Do not add plate-knight armor, undead anatomy, Indigenous or sacred motifs, modern tactical gear, firearms, extra weapons, people, limbs, changed grip, text, logo, watermark, or gore.

fallback.reason: ImageGen returned RGB checkerboard pixels rather than an alpha channel

rejected_attempts.reason: brown matte and internal subject damage

fallback.selected_method: border-connected near-neutral checker key; brightness >=190; channel spread <=32; one foreground component; Gaussian alpha sigma 0.65; nearest-opaque subject-color fringe decontamination
